coordinate_note: Raw FBX centimeters, Y up, forward +Z. Blender imports to meters, +Z up, character forward −Y; backward displacement is Blender +Y. N rig is meter world identity. Source Armature retains scale .01 and +90-degree X conversion. Hips is top-level animated bone; no separate root bone.
limitations: FBX contains skeleton animation only, no mesh/sole or contact constraints; contact timing is inferred from ankle/toe kinematics.

Native cubic-auto-time-independent FBX keys (8456/0x2108) are imported by Blender 4.3.2 as linear samples. Native raw first/last secants are measured; native FBX exact cubic endpoint derivatives are not resolved by the importer.
Analytic endpoint derivatives here are for the imported piecewise-linear channels and normalized quaternion FK, explicitly not native FBX cubic derivatives.
No source leg/torso/gaze retiming or edits, N carry modification, target action authoring, mesh fitting, collision claim, or engine work performed.

foot_support_proxy_windows.definition: World horizontal bone-head speed <0.05 m/s, excluding isolated windows <=20 ms. Skeleton proxy only; derivatives use quarter-frame samples and 1ms/0.1ms near endpoints.
